title: Add GitHub beta release setup preflight
summary: Add a release setup preflight that checks GitHub remote, GitHub CLI/auth posture, private beta workflow wiring, and optional GitHub environment availability before dispatching the beta workflow.
reason: The local beta workflow dry-run passed, but dispatching the real workflow is blocked until GitHub remote and GitHub CLI/auth/environment setup are visible and repeatably checked.
behavior_before: Operators had local release dry-runs and artifact gates, but no single command that explained whether the checkout was ready to dispatch the GitHub Actions beta workflow.
behavior_after: Operators can run a setup preflight that reports missing remotes, missing or unauthenticated GitHub CLI, workflow wiring, and optional beta/stable GitHub environment checks without exposing secrets.
manual_validation: Test-PrivateBetaGitHubSetup.ps1 normal mode - failed as expected in current checkout: missing GitHub remote and gh CLI
git diff --check targeted GitHub setup preflight files - passed
refresh_summaries targeted GitHub setup preflight paths - passed
rollback_plan: Remove the GitHub setup preflight script, tests, docs references, generated summaries, and this change packet.
notes: This is release setup tooling only. It must not install GitHub CLI, mutate git remotes, create secrets, or dispatch workflows by itself.
